name: Cost efficiency

subjectOf.text: The cost savings of the multimanager series trust model are a confluence mechanism: they let a growing number of smaller hedge fund advisers reach retail investors by launching a mutual fund.
subjectOf.abstract: The cost savings associated with the multimanager series trust governance model allow the increasing number of smaller hedge fund investment advisers to attract retail investors by setting up a mutual fund.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Confluence of Mutual and Private Funds (2016). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2715083
